editorial: When a Category‑5 hurricane roars over a sleepy coastal town, you never feel safe. Thrash turns every wave into a predator, merging the ferocity of nature with a visceral shark horror that keeps the stakes absurdly high. The film’s standout 3K drone footage of the storm surge feels almost sentient, as if the water itself is a character intent on devouring the shore. A slight pacing hiccup comes in the third act, where the frenetic chase slows to a grueling river‑bank standoff that drags a touch. Ideal for anyone who loves to feel the pulse behind a watery nightmare that keeps you on the edge of your seat.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of high-pressure survival stories who crave a pulse‑quickening, water‑borne terror.
